original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook hardening a CentOS 9 server: disables root SSH login, enforces password complexity, installs fail2ban, and configures auditd.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Harden CentOS 9 server
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    ssh_port: 22
    allowed_ssh_users: []
    fail2ban_bantime: 3600
    fail2ban_findtime: 600
    fail2ban_maxretry: 5
    password_min_length: 14
    password_min_classes: 4

  handlers:
    - name: Restart sshd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted

    - name: Restart fail2ban
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: fail2ban
        state: restarted

    - name: Restart auditd
      ansible.builtin.command: service auditd restart
      changed_when: true

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure EPEL repository is installed
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: epel-release
        state: present

    - name: Update all packages to latest
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name: "*"
        state: latest
        update_cache: true

    - name: Install required hardening packages
      ansible.builtin.dnf:
        name:
          - fail2ban
          - fail2ban-firewalld
          - audit
          - audit-libs
          - libpwquality
          - firewalld
          - openssh-server
          - policycoreutils-python-utils
        state: present

    # ---------------- SSH Hardening ----------------
    - name: Ensure /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Deploy hardened SSH configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-hardening.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0600'
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - SSH hardening
          Port {{ ssh_port }}
          Protocol 2
          PermitRootLogin no
          PasswordAuthentication no
          PubkeyAuthentication yes
          PermitEmptyPasswords no
          ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
          KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
          UsePAM yes
          X11Forwarding no
          AllowTcpForwarding no
          AllowAgentForwarding no
          PermitUserEnvironment no
          ClientAliveInterval 300
          ClientAliveCountMax 2
          LoginGraceTime 30
          MaxAuthTries 3
          MaxSessions 4
          MaxStartups 10:30:60
          IgnoreRhosts yes
          HostbasedAuthentication no
          StrictModes yes
          LogLevel VERBOSE
          Banner /etc/issue.net
          Ciphers chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com,aes256-gcm@openssh.com,aes128-gcm@openssh.com,aes256-ctr,aes192-ctr,aes128-ctr
          MACs hmac-sha2-512-etm@openssh.com,hmac-sha2-256-etm@openssh.com,umac-128-etm@openssh.com
          KexAlgorithms curve25519-sha256,curve25519-sha256@libssh.org,diffie-hellman-group16-sha512,diffie-hellman-group18-sha512
          {% if allowed_ssh_users | length > 0 %}
          AllowUsers {{ allowed_ssh_users | join(' ') }}
          {% endif %}
      notify: Restart sshd

    - name: Deploy SSH banner
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/issue.net
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          ******************************************************************
          *           Authorized access only. All activity is logged.      *
          *  Disconnect IMMEDIATELY if you are not an authorized user.     *
          ******************************************************************

    - name: Validate sshd configuration
      ansible.builtin.command: sshd -t
      changed_when: false

    # ---------------- Password Complexity ----------------
    - name: Configure pwquality for password complexity
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/security/pwquality.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - Password complexity policy
          minlen = {{ password_min_length }}
          minclass = {{ password_min_classes }}
          dcredit = -1
          ucredit = -1
          lcredit = -1
          ocredit = -1
          maxrepeat = 3
          maxclassrepeat = 4
          gecoscheck = 1
          dictcheck = 1
          usercheck = 1
          enforcing = 1
          retry = 3
          difok = 5
          enforce_for_root

    - name: Configure password aging in /etc/login.defs
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/login.defs
        regexp: "^{{ item.key }}"
        line: "{{ item.key }} {{ item.value }}"
        state: present
      loop:
        - { key: 'PASS_MAX_DAYS', value: '90' }
        - { key: 'PASS_MIN_DAYS', value: '1' }
        - { key: 'PASS_WARN_AGE', value: '7' }
        - { key: 'PASS_MIN_LEN', value: '{{ password_min_length }}' }
        - { key: 'UMASK', value: '027' }

    - name: Configure password history and lockout via authselect
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        authselect select sssd with-faillock --force || authselect select minimal with-faillock --force
        authselect apply-changes
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      changed_when: true

    - name: Configure faillock
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/security/faillock.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
